svg.data-port-modes-qsfp28: 10, 40 and 100 Gigabit Ethernet - data sheet Table 2, "16 QSFP28 ports capable of 10Gb, 40Gb, and 100Gb Ethernet". Cisco publishes no per-optic list for this chassis and points at the Cisco Optics Compatibility Matrix instead, so this is the rate list and not an optics list
svg.data-port-modes-sfp-plus: 10 Gigabit Ethernet - data sheet Table 2, "20 SFP+ ports capable of 10Gb Ethernet", with no dual-rate note beside it. The chassis-wide sentence "10, 25, 40, 100, and 400 Gigabit Ethernet interface types across the ASR 9903 chassis" covers the Port Expansion Cards as well and is not a claim about these twenty cages
svg.data-power-input-ac: 200-240 VAC high line, 90-130 VAC low line, 50-60 Hz
svg.data-power-input-dc: -48 VDC nominal, -40.5 to -72 VDC, 40 A max per module
svg.data-power-redundancy-ac: 2+2 at high line, 3+1 at low line
svg.data-air-filter: ASR-9903-FILTER, one serviceable filter on the front
svg.data-ethernet: 10-Gbps IEEE 802.3ae, 40/100-Gbps IEEE 802.3ba, 100GE PHY monitoring, IEEE 802.x flow control, full duplex, per-port byte and packet counters
svg.data-timing: 2 x BITS RJ-45, ToD RJ-45, 10 MHz and 1 PPS SMB per RP, IEEE 1588 PTP telecom profiles G.8265.1/G.8275.1/G.8275.2 and SyncE
svg.data-usb: 1 x USB class A per RP
svg.data-nebs: designed to meet SR-3580 NEBS Criteria Level 3, GR-1089-CORE and GR-63-CORE
svg.data-safety: UL/CSA/IEC/EN 60950-1, IEC/EN 60825 laser safety, ACA TS001, AS/NZS 60950
svg.data-emc: FCC Class A, ICES 003 Class A, AS/NZS 3548 Class A, CISPR 22 (EN55022) Class A, VCCI Class A, BSMI Class A
svg.data-immunity: IEC/EN-61000-4-2 ESD (8 kV contact, 15 kV air), -4-3 radiated (10 V/m), -4-4 EFT (2 kV power, 1 kV signal), -4-5 surge (AC 4 kV CM / 2 kV DM, signal 1 kV, DC 1 kV), -4-6 conducted (10 Vrms), -4-8 power-frequency magnetic field (30 A/m), -4-11 dips and interruptions
